snippet.title: Deadly Obsession - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
#deadlyobsession 
"Deadly Obsession" is an intense visual novel where you are the main character. In this game, you awaken in a mysterious, unfamiliar basement, only to realize you've been kidnapped by a dangerously obsessed yandere. His motives are twisted and every interaction teeters on the edge of love and madness.

As the story unfolds, your choices determine your fate: Will you escape? or will his charm and obsession lure you into staying by his side? Each decision shapes the narrative, unraveling dark secrets and emotional depths.
Prepare for a thrilling journey of psychological tension, complex relationships, and a fight for control over your destiny. Some decisions will influence the story, everything has consequences.
